title: The Choir That Ate Its Echo
timeline_origin: First PCM sample of the mastered WAV; MP3 uses encoder delay/padding metadata. No musical entrance offset is added.

cues.text: More light. More names. More words. More fire.
I sent a voice into the room.
More light. More names. More words. More fire.
I sent it back before it knew.
The bell is ringing for the ringing.
There is a person trying to speak.
We fill the sky with perfect echoes.
I cannot hear the one I seek.
The tower grows; the window vanishes.
The count is true; the song is lost.
My voice has made the doorway smaller.
I must be answerable for its cost.
Put down the sound that will not listen.
I put it down. I leave the air.
One word. One breath. One room. One window.
The quiet is a kind of care.
